purpose: Freeze how target discovery pivots after corrected replay, rare-program qualification, Bayesian source/operator reassessment, multimodal support, and survivor comparisons so failures are repaired at the failed layer rather than reinterpreted post hoc.
global_rules: Fix only the layer that failed; do not lower or rewrite a passed upstream gate to rescue a downstream failure.
NOT_ESTIMABLE remains NOT_ESTIMABLE and never becomes PASS by convenience.
No protected pathology/clinical outcome may be opened to choose, tune, rescue or redefine the foundation target.
Donor is the primary biological replication unit; cells/nuclei improve within-donor measurement precision only.
Source/technology/operator is an observation process, not a biological label.
Unavailable evidence is missing, never zero.
No multimodal evidence can rescue a foundation candidate that failed its mandatory RNA/relational gate.
No single scalar evidence score may collapse distinct evidence classes.
Every redesigned method after a failure requires a new prospective freeze before real outcome opening.

RELATIONAL_PASS.next: Run all applicable candidate gates plus rare-program fitness; no automatic promotion.

RELATIONAL_FAIL.next: Continue C1/C3/C6. Do not redesign or rescue C2/C4 from downstream evidence.

RELATIONAL_NOT_ESTIMABLE.next: Continue lawful C1/C3/C6 qualification. Only design a new prospective relational experiment if unresolved C2/C4 could change the final target decision.

TD57C_DIVERGENCE_OR_NOVEL_PATTERN.next: Freeze as divergence; do not reinterpret as success/failure. Design a new prospective locality experiment only if decision-relevant.

SOURCE_STRADDLE.next: Record universality not established separately from formal heterogeneity. Do not infer biological heterogeneity from threshold discordance alone.

IMPLEMENTATION_OR_CUSTODY_FAILURE.next: No biological interpretation. Preserve evidence and diagnose execution. A rerun is allowed only if the one-shot custody rules prove the attempt was not spent.

rare_program_contingencies.RARE_PROGRAM_FITNESS_PASS: Candidate remains eligible; PASS does not select the target.
rare_program_contingencies.RARE_PROGRAM_FITNESS_FAIL: Eliminate the candidate from foundation selection. Do not lower rarity/recurrence thresholds after seeing the failure.
rare_program_contingencies.RARE_PROGRAM_FITNESS_NOT_ESTIMABLE: Do not promote on rare biology. Candidate may remain unresolved only under already-authorized non-rare gates; unresolved rare fitness must be explicit in final adjudication.
rare_program_contingencies.BIOLOGICAL_PROGRAM_WITH_SOURCE_SHIFTED_P: Preserve as biology; model program state separately from prevalence/observability. Do not globally regress source away.
rare_program_contingencies.SOURCE_SPECIFIC_BIOLOGICAL_PROGRAM: Retain as specialist/source-specific biology; cannot establish universal foundation evidence.
rare_program_contingencies.BIOLOGICAL_PROGRAM_PARTIALLY_OBSERVATION: Retain biological direction with support-aware uncertainty/abstention; low support cannot be encoded as biological absence.
rare_program_contingencies.OBSERVATION_OPERATOR_ARTIFACT: Retire the program as biological qualification evidence; retain it as an adversarial technical control.
rare_program_contingencies.DONOR_PRIVATE_UNUSUAL_STATE: Retain as unusual/uncertain biology but do not promote to recurrent population-level program.

historical_rare1_rare5_rule.identity: rare1 and rare5 are thresholds on the same frozen innovation direction, not separate programs

bayesian_method_contingencies.CALIBRATION_PASS: Real fit still requires separate explicit authority and frozen program definitions.
bayesian_method_contingencies.CALIBRATION_FAIL: Stop method; redesign prospectively. Never tune against historical rare1/rare5, corrected replay, target tournament, pathology or protected outcomes.
bayesian_method_contingencies.SAMPLER_NOT_ESTIMABLE: Stop method implementation; change sampler only under a new prospective calibration freeze.
bayesian_method_contingencies.PRIOR_SENSITIVE: Do not use posterior for deciding rare-program status; redesign estimand/prior robustness prospectively.
bayesian_method_contingencies.ONE_SOURCE_ONLY_FALSE_SHARED: Estimand failure; reject model even if convergence metrics are good.
bayesian_method_contingencies.SIGN_FLIP_FALSE_SHARED: Estimand failure; reject model even if convergence metrics are good.
bayesian_method_contingencies.DUPLICATE_INFLATION: Ledger/method failure; reject before real fitting.
bayesian_method_contingencies.NEW_SOURCE_PREDICTIVE_ONLY: Secondary summary only; cannot rescue observed-source recurrence failure.

candidate_specific_pivots.C1_FAILS_RARE_PRESERVATION: Eliminate C1 as foundation target; C6 also cannot survive as a valid shared+query composite unless a prospectively redesigned shared block is independently qualified.
candidate_specific_pivots.C3_FAILS_QUERY_SPECIFIC_VALUE_OR_RARE_PR: Eliminate C3; C6 and C4 lose their query-measured dependency and cannot remain valid in current form.
candidate_specific_pivots.C6_FAILS_INCREMENT_OVER_C1_C3: Retain qualified C1/C3; eliminate C6. Do not keep C6 merely because it is more complex.
candidate_specific_pivots.C2_FAILS_REPLAY_OR_RARE_RELATIONAL_PRESE: Eliminate C2 and block C4; continue C1/C3/C6.
candidate_specific_pivots.C4_FAILS_INCREMENT_OVER_C6: Retain qualified C6 and other survivors; eliminate C4.
candidate_specific_pivots.C5_FAILS_REGULATORY_QUALIFICATION: Do not use regulatory specialist target. This does not invalidate a qualified foundation RNA target.
candidate_specific_pivots.ALL_FOUNDATION_CANDIDATES_FAIL: No target selection. Reopen architecture prospectively using observed failure signatures; do not revive a failed candidate by relaxed thresholds.
candidate_specific_pivots.MULTIPLE_SURVIVORS: Run protected head-to-head comparisons using predeclared pairwise questions, especially C6 vs C1/C3 and C4 vs C6.
candidate_specific_pivots.ONE_SURVIVOR: Eligible for protected confirmation only; explicit target-decision authority still required.
candidate_specific_pivots.WINNER_DEPENDS_ON_UNRESOLVED_C2_C4: Stop final selection and run a new prospective relational experiment if estimable; otherwise carry unresolved status rather than choosing by convenience.

multimodal_teacher_student_pivots.ATAC_ADDS_COHERENT_RNA_RECOVERABLE_INCRE: Use as probabilistic/recoverable privileged teacher block after target freeze, with donor-held-out recoverability qualification.
multimodal_teacher_student_pivots.ATAC_ADDS_COHERENT_BUT_RNA_UNRECOVERABLE: Keep teacher-private; student expresses biological uncertainty rather than exact point prediction.
multimodal_teacher_student_pivots.ATAC_INCREMENT_NOT_DONOR_RECURRENT: Do not promote as shared teacher biology; retain as uncertain/source-specific evidence if appropriate.
multimodal_teacher_student_pivots.REGULATORY_GRAPH_TOPOLOGY_FAILS_CONTROLS: Do not hard-wire graph message passing; use regulatory feature/program evidence as soft privileged support only.
multimodal_teacher_student_pivots.SPATIAL_PANEL_CANNOT_MEASURE_PROGRAM: Classify spatial evidence as unavailable, not negative.
multimodal_teacher_student_pivots.MORABITO_DISAGREES_WITH_SAME_NUCLEUS_RES: Treat as transport/replication tension; inspect donor/source/measurement support without averaging discordance away.
multimodal_teacher_student_pivots.MULTIMODAL_SUPPORT_FAILS_AFTER_TARGET_FR: Does not retroactively redefine the foundation target; limits biological interpretation/teacher enrichment only.

architecture_redesign_hierarchy_if_neede: 3_if_query/shared constituent fails, redesign that constituent prospectively rather than preserve composite shell
4_if all foundation candidates fail, construct a new target family from failure signatures with new synthetic and real-data qualification
5_multimodal teacher-private decomposition is preferred over forcing unrecoverable biology into deterministic student loss
non_authority_statement: This contract freezes contingencies only. It authorizes no replay, target selection, representation selection, TD60, Stage4 or real training.
